'''Pennsylvania pot pie''' is a Pennsylvania Dutch [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]], consisting of meat, vegetables, and squares of pie crust.

==Ingredients==

=== Dumplings/noodles ===
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* ⅓ cup plus 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] cold water

=== Soup ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] water
* 1 can [[Cookbook:Green Bean|green beans]]
* 1–3 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] stewing [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]], to taste

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] chicken in water until tender.
#Meanwhile, prepare noodle dough following the first 5 steps of the [[Cookbook:Flaky Pie Crust|Flaky Pie Crust]] procedure, using the ingredients above. [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]] and [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] are replaced with pepper and shortening, respectively.
#On a floured board, [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll dough]] about twice as thick as ordinary pie crust (about a 9-inch circle or 8 x 10-inch rectangle).
#Cut dough into roughly 2-inch squares.
#Remove chicken from broth. Shred chicken, discarding bones and skin.
#Stir pot pie squares into boiling broth a few at a time, being careful not to let them stick together. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] 6 minutes.
#Add chicken and green beans. Simmer for 10–15 minutes.
#Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Note: Pot pie squares will dissolve into the broth around the edges, but remain relatively firm in their centers.  This is normal.
*A range of fresh vegetables including fresh green beans, cubed [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], finely diced [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], etc. can be added after the chicken if cooking times are planned carefully.
*Cooked chicken or [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]], or bite-sized pieces of [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]] can be substituted for the raw chicken. In this case, substitute chicken [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]] for water.
